lines.text: Paul tells the Philippians to rejoice in the Lord, and says believers glory in Christ Jesus and put no confidence in the flesh.
Paul says he was circumcised on the eighth day, of the tribe of Judah, a Hebrew of Hebrews, and a Pharisee.
Paul says that as to zeal he was persecuting the church, and as to righteousness in the law he was faultless.
Paul counts all things as rubbish compared to knowing Christ, and wants the righteousness that comes through hope in Christ.
Paul wants to know Christ and the power of His resurrection, so that he may attain to the resurrection from the dead.
